# OpenBusinessERP

> Self-hosted, open-source ERP (AGPL-3.0) for businesses in any country: quotes, orders, invoices, CRM, appointments, stock, purchasing, bank reconciliation and double-entry bookkeeping, in 44 languages and 79 currencies. Desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, or Docker on your own server. By DataDrivenConstruction.

## Repo structure

- `backend/` - Python / FastAPI API server, SQLAlchemy 2 (async), Pydantic 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL
- `frontend/` - React 18 + TypeScript single-page app built with Vite
- `modules/` - business-area modules
- `desktop/` - desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) with embedded PostgreSQL
- `deploy/` - Docker and server configs
- `docs/` - user manual and developer docs

## Key facts

- **Sales**: quotes, orders, deliveries, invoices and credit notes in one chain; recurring invoices; Stripe and Mollie payment links
- **Stock and purchasing**: catalogue, warehouses, stocktakes, moving-average valuation, three-step purchase matching
- **Bank**: camt.053, camt.054, MT940 and CSV import with matching rules; aging and dunning
- **Accounting**: double-entry ledger, immutable postings, locked periods, gap-free numbering, audit log
- **Countries**: tax presets for 44 countries; SKR03/SKR04, EKR and KMU charts; SAF-T 2.0 and DATEV export
- **E-invoicing**: EN 16931 (CII, UBL), Peppol BIS 3.0, XRechnung 3.0, ZUGFeRD 2.1 / Factur-X
- **API**: REST under `/api/v1/` with OpenAPI schema
- **Limits**: nothing is certified; no payroll or tax filing; file-based bank import only. See the Limits section of README.md
